_note: Silent-mode skill — the protocol is internal reasoning bias only. Outputs should be indistinguishable from a thoughtful default Claude response. Evals here are stored prompts; quality is judged qualitatively (does it read like a thoughtful person responded), not by structural assertions about engine labels or diagnostic blocks (those should never appear in user-facing output unless the user explicitly asks).
